M1Typography › 01 Typeface — the Table 2 script specimen

There was no specimen of the nine scripts. A card now shows each sample in its Noto Sans family, bound to its new script variable. Gurmukhi and Odia name their families for code, because Figma's font library does not have them.

DBIM §4.2: Noto Sans for all scripts.

X2Event card — dates and locations

The event date and location lines are now Grey 03, so the event title leads.

Grey 03 is 6.29:1 on white.

X2Vacancy card — published date

The “Published Date” label and the date are now Grey 03, the same as every other card's date.

Consistency with the other cards.

X2Content card — description

The description under the title is now Grey 03. Before, title and description were the same style and colour.

Gives the card a hierarchy.

X2Minister — designation under the name

“Hon'ble Union Minister” is now Grey 03 under the name in Deep Earthy Brown.

Name first, role second.

X2Header — search box placeholder

“Search...” is now the placeholder grey, so the empty field doesn't read as filled.

Same role as the form placeholders.

X7Ministry menu dropdown

Translucent black with background blur becomes solid Grey 03 (new role bg/neutral/strong). White text measures 6.29:1.

The manual has no basis for blur, and it reserves black for the emblem.
